scope: One development environment feasibility check; no model trial or main benchmark adoption
prerequisites: P3-01 through P3-04 completed and independently evaluated with no unresolved infrastructure or accounting error
No concurrent model trial or other workload in the research VM
At least 15 GiB free in research VM and 20 GiB on host before pull; recheck after unpacking

phases.purpose: Pull only this digest and measure unpacked size and remaining storage
Check CPU compatibility, Python, repo path, base revision, clean state and sanitized history
Apply no agent patch and run the official V2 verifier in a fresh container
Apply reference patch mechanically in a separate fresh evaluator container; never display its text to researcher or generator

evaluation_isolation.public_report: hashes, sizes, status, duration, resource measurements, reward and infrastructure classification only

failure_policy: Retain all attempts. Do not repeat a task failure until it passes; record and diagnose infrastructure failure before a new explicitly versioned attempt.
local_adaptation: Use existing isolated Colima/Docker executor rather than Modal/Harbor; record container policy differences. This is not reproduction of published model scores.
selection_reason: Candidate 12 has coupled filter, loader, dumper and template contracts; Python also reduces new runtime integration work.

alternatives_not_selected_now.candidate_1: Keep as a subsequent cross-language dependency candidate; introduces a different toolchain before local V2 evaluation works.
alternatives_not_selected_now.candidate_3: Common flag propagation appears mostly one-way, making it a useful control but weaker main mechanism candidate.
alternatives_not_selected_now.all_images: Unnecessary storage and setup work before one environment is validated.
alternatives_not_selected_now.v1_evaluator: Different release and evaluation contract; cannot use it for V2 results.

success_criteria: Immutable image and public input parity verified
Probe matches intended base commit and exposes no unwanted history or host access
Empty patch unresolved and reference patch resolved, without silently excluding failures
Time, CPU, memory, unpacked image size and free space recorded
